chunks: 962 - It is narrated from Hilqām ibn Abī Hilqām that he said:
I came to Abū Ibrāhīm عليه السلام and said to him: “May I be your ransom, teach me a comprehensive supplication for this world and the Hereafter, and make it concise.”
So he said: “Say after Fajr until the sun rises: ‘Glory be to Allah, the Magnificent, and with His praise. I seek forgiveness from Allah and ask Him from His bounty.’”

Hilqām said: “I had been the worst off in condition among my household, and I did not realize until an inheritance came to me from a man whom I did not know there was kinship between me and him. And today I am the most well-off of my household in wealth, and that is only from what my master, the righteous servant, taught me عليه السلام.”

key_terms.الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ: the righteous servant, a title for the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.سُبْحَانَ: a declaration of Allah's transcendence and glorification
key_terms.مِيرَاثٌ: an inheritance received from a relative

ai.seo_question: What concise supplication did Imām Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام teach for after Fajr and before sunrise?
ai.summary: This hadith records a concise du'a taught by Abū Ibrāhīm Imām Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar al-Kāẓim عليه السلام for recitation after the Fajr prayer until sunrise. It joins tasbih, seeking forgiveness, and asking for divine bounty, and the narrator reports a marked improvement in his material condition after acting upon it.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.962 - Hilqam ibn Abi Hilqam narrated that He said:
"I came to Abu Ibrahim (Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as)) and said:
'May I be your sacrifice, teach me a supplication that encompasses both worldly and otherworldly affairs and make it concise.'
Imam (as) said: 'Recite after the Fajr prayer until the sun rises: "Subhan Allah (swt) al-Azim wa bihamdihi (Glory be to Allah (swt), the Great, and praise be to Him). I seek forgiveness from Allah (swt) and ask Him for His bounty."'
Hilqam then said: 'I was the worst off among my household, but I did not know what had happened until an inheritance came to me from a man whom I did not know to have any kinship with me. And today, I am the wealthiest among my household, and this is solely due to what my master, the righteous servant, taught me (as).'"
